text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Executing Operation: "Rest."
Upon completion, I shall return to duty immediately.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"—This is Mihono Bourbon in flight above.
Visual on a giant rampaging robot in the city... engaging."

text_block_list.name: Giant Robot
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOO!
DADYYYYYYYYYY!!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
!? Voiceprint match... nearly identical to Dad's.
Could it be...

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father Robot?
text_block_list.text:
Grrr... Father flatten town!
Then, make big training ground here!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Requesting the father-type robot to halt.
Flattening residential areas causes trouble for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father Robot?
text_block_list.text:
DAUGHTER! DAD IS WORRIED!
ARE YOU IN AN ENVIRONMENT WHERE YOU CAN GROW PROPERLY?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Personality mismatch with father.
Understood as a runaway state caused by thought circuit error.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Don't worry, Dad.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My father taught me
the importance of hard work.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
And Master...
believes in that strength, and helps it grow.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I will... become stronger here.
Please believe in us and watch over me.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father Robot?
text_block_list.text:
I see... I'm glad I got to hear that.
...Also, call me once in a while, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Understood, Dad.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father Robot
text_block_list.text:
NO. YOU DO NOT NEED TO UNDERSTAND.
I AM SPEAKING TO THE CORE INSIDE YOU.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? The main body?

"—*Beep, bzzzzt*...
Interior, deploying monitor from cockpit."

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Main Body?
text_block_list.text:
"Ta-da... Hello.
I am the true pilot controlling Mihono Bourbon."

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Main Body?
text_block_list.text: "It's already nighttime, so you really ought to get up."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
C-Cockpit?
...Is there someone piloting me?

She seemed preoccupied with what happened in her dream
and wasn't able to get a good rest...
